summary: Iteration 5 (Gaji Pegawai / payroll + attendance-on-login + remove Upah per Kg) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_payroll.py + 26/26 regression PASS (backend_test.py + test_iter4_reports.py). GET /api/payroll?outlet_id=<uuid>&period=YYYY-MM returns employees[] with the full field set (gaji_pokok, tunjangan_kasir, kehadiran, lembur_shifts, uang_makan, wash_kg/pcs, iron_kg/pcs, bonus_cuci, bonus_setrika, trips, antar_jemput, perjalanan_dinas, kasbon, total). Formulas verified per employee: total = gaji_pokok+tunjangan+uang_makan+bonus_cuci+bonus_setrika+antar_jemput+perjalanan-kasbon; uang_makan = 15000*(kehadiran+lembur); bonus_cuci = ((wash_kg)+(wash_pcs*5))/10*3000; bonus_setrika = (iron_kg+iron_pcs)*1000; antar_jemput = 5000*trips. POST /api/payroll/manual upserts (period+employee_id unique) and next /api/payroll reflects the update (uang_makan & total change). POST/PUT /api/employees persists gaji_pokok & tunjangan_kasir (verified via GET). POST /api/auth/login for pegawai inserts an attendance row for today (idempotent per day — verified: repeated logins in the same day do NOT increment kehadiran). Kurir advance on pickup/delivery order inserts a 'trip' work_log per (order,employee) — dedup verified (double advance on same order = +1 trip only). GET /api/reports/employees per_employee has no wage/upah/wage_rate fields. Frontend (390x844 mobile web): Owner login OK. Setelan > Gaji Pegawai (/manage/gaji): outlet chips (Kalimulya/Pulomas/Ujungberung), month chips (Sep..May 2026); after tapping Kalimulya, Total Gaji card renders (Rp6.735.000 for 3 pegawai), per-employee cards expand showing all breakdown rows including 'Kehadiran 0 hari + lembur 7' and 'Total Diterima'. 'Ubah Lembur / Perjalanan Dinas' modal opens; setting lembur=7 & perjalanan=175000 -> Simpan closes modal, total updates from Rp2.400.000 -> Rp2.680.000 (matches formula), Perjalanan Dinas row shows Rp175.000. Laporan > Pegawai has NO 'Upah per Kg' input and NO wage-rate testID; only kg cuci/kg setrika are shown. Setelan > Pegawai edit form has 'Gaji Pokok' and 'Tunjangan Kasir' fields side-by-side (verified for Andi Admin: 1500000 / 300000). Deprecated shadow* console warnings persist (cosmetic, carry-over).

ui_bugs.issue: Initial outletId state does not sync when session.outlets loads asynchronously. On first entry to /manage/gaji, no outlet chip appears selected and the payroll query stays disabled (enabled: !!outletId), so an EmptyState 'Belum ada pegawai' briefly shows until the user manually taps a chip. Suggested fix: add a useEffect that sets outletId = session?.currentOutletId || outlets[0]?.id when outletId is '' and outlets.length > 0.

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent RN-Web deprecation 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' (carried over from prior iterations)

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix outletId initial-sync race in /app/frontend/app/manage/gaji.tsx (add useEffect to set outletId once outlets load). Manual tap works as a workaround.
OPTIONAL: add DELETE /api/employees/{id} endpoint (currently 405 Method Not Allowed) so TEST_ employees created by regression tests can be cleaned up. Non-blocking.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* to boxShadow across components to silence RN-Web deprecation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1577 lines — still monolithic. Suggest splitting into services/orders/reports/payroll/masterdata modules.
Payroll formulas in server.py:1478-1485 exactly match spec (uang_makan/bonus_cuci/bonus_setrika/antar_jemput/total).
Attendance-on-login is idempotent via unique index (employee_id, day) — safe against repeated logins in same day. Verified.
advance_status inserts a 'trip' work_log with exists-check on (order_id, employee_id, stage='trip') — correct dedup. Verified.
GET /api/payroll uses per-employee sub-queries in a Python loop (N+1 pattern). Acceptable for small teams (<20) but should be batched to a single JOIN for scale.
GET /api/reports/employees per_employee correctly excludes any wage/upah field — matches spec.
gaji.tsx: initial state race — outletId set once from a possibly-empty outlets on first render; needs useEffect to sync (see ui_bugs).
gaji.tsx does not pass outletId when tapping edit modal — save uses `period` from state; verified correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed critical flows (after workaround for outletId race)
